title: Pedestrian/Animal tries to cross over the road disregarding traffic signal
situation: Pedestrian/Animal tries to cross over the road disregarding traffic signal
communication_type: Inter Vehicle & Traffic Signal Communication, Between Pedestrian and Detector present roadside
description: A pedestrian/animal is trying to cross over the road, i.e. obstruction is present on the road but will be cleared soon, possibly with cooperation with vehicles.

Yes, in most cases, pedestrians will be able to cross over swiftly thus causing minor deceleration for vehicles, which is better looked over.
